mechanism: Layered agent memory with bounded working context, episodic ledger and persistent knowledge, managed by the agent through checkpoint and distill actions
evidence_scope: SOMA separates bounded working attention (L1), immutable episodic traces (L2), persistent sovereign knowledge (L3), and environment grounding (L4).
evidence_role: This paper introduces SOMA (Sovereign Operative Memory Architecture), a four-layer cognitive operating system for autonomous agents.
